method: ENTIRELY from ONE AMH page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED. No passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable and every statement must be verified by a person against a current subscription. ⚠️ AMH STATES THIS CHAPTER DRAWS EXTENSIVELY FROM THE AUSTRALIAN IMMUNISATION HANDBOOK, WHICH IS OPEN AT immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au AND WAS NOT RETRIEVED. That is the single largest improvable gap here: the schedule below is a paraphrase of a paraphrase of an open source. ⚠️ THE PAGE DEFERS TO THE HANDBOOK IN AT LEAST TWELVE PLACES, INCLUDING FOR ALL COVID-19 VACCINE RECOMMENDATIONS. NO VACCINE DOSE OR VOLUME APPEARS; the tetanus immunoglobulin units and the corticosteroid immunosuppression thresholds are the only numeric drug quantities and are queued.

claims.claim: ⚠️ AMH STATES THIS CHAPTER DRAWS EXTENSIVELY FROM THE AUSTRALIAN IMMUNISATION HANDBOOK AT immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au. The recommended vaccinations ARE CONSIDERED BEST PRACTICE BY THE AUSTRALIAN TECHNICAL ADVISORY GROUP ON IMMUNISATION and MOST ARE FUNDED BY THE NATIONAL IMMUNISATION PROGRAM. ⚠️ THE TABLE RECOMMENDS ANTIGENS RATHER THAN SPECIFIC VACCINES, as some vaccines combine different antigens, and VACCINES PROTECTING AGAINST THE SAME DISEASE FROM DIFFERENT MANUFACTURERS ARE USUALLY INTERCHANGEABLE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PREGNANCY: ALL PREGNANT WOMEN ARE RECOMMENDED TO RECEIVE INACTIVATED INFLUENZA VACCINE AT ANY STAGE OF EACH PREGNANCY, PARTICULARLY IF THE SECOND OR THIRD TRIMESTER WILL BE IN THE INFLUENZA SEASON; PERTUSSIS AS dTpa EACH PREGNANCY, PREFERABLY BETWEEN 20 AND 32 WEEKS GESTATION; AND RSV VACCINE EACH PREGNANCY BETWEEN 28 AND 36 WEEKS GESTATION. ⚠️ IMMUNISATION DURING PREGNANCY PROTECTS THE NEWBORN UNTIL THEY CAN RECEIVE THEIR FIRST VACCINATION -- AT 6 WEEKS FOR PERTUSSIS, AT 6 MONTHS FOR INFLUENZA
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ LIVE VACCINATIONS SUCH AS MMR SHOULD BE AVOIDED DURING PREGNANCY due to theoretical risk of disease transmission, and WOMEN ARE ADVISED TO AVOID PREGNANCY FOR 28 DAYS AFTER VACCINATION. ⚠️ HOWEVER, INADVERTENT EXPOSURE JUST BEFORE OR DURING PREGNANCY HAS NOT BEEN SHOWN TO CAUSE FETAL HARM AND IS NOT A REASON TO TERMINATE THE PREGNANCY -- SEEK SPECIALIST ADVICE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ PRETERM BABIES: PROVIDED THEY ARE HEALTHY, IMMUNISE ACCORDING TO USUAL CHRONOLOGICAL AGE WITHOUT CORRECTING FOR PREMATURITY. Children with chronic heart or lung disease, asplenia, immunosuppression or HIV infection, or preterm babies, are A HIGH PRIORITY FOR IMMUNISATION, and SOMETIMES A VACCINE OUTSIDE THE NATIONAL IMMUNISATION PROGRAM SHOULD BE USED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: CATCH-UP VACCINATION: ⚠️ OFFER CHILDREN WITH A POOR HISTORY OF VACCINATION THE FULL COURSE APPROPRIATE FOR THEIR AGE -- SERIOUS ADVERSE EFFECTS ARE UNLIKELY IF EXTRA VACCINE DOSES ARE GIVEN. ⚠️ THE IMMUNE RESPONSE IS UNAFFECTED BY EXCEEDING THE RECOMMENDED INTERVALS BETWEEN VACCINATIONS -- THERE IS NO NEED TO GIVE EXTRA DOSES OR RESTART THE SCHEDULE. WRITTEN EVIDENCE OF VACCINATIONS IS IMPORTANT AS RECALL CAN BE FAULTY. A CATCH-UP CALCULATOR IS AVAILABLE for children under 10 years on the National Immunisation Program
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IMMUNOSUPPRESSED PATIENTS: INACTIVATED VACCINES ARE RECOMMENDED BUT THERE MAY BE A POOR IMMUNE RESPONSE. ⚠️ MOST LIVE VACCINES ARE CONTRAINDICATED IN SEVERELY IMMUNOSUPPRESSED PATIENTS DUE TO THE RISK OF INFECTION FROM THE VACCINE VIRUS -- INFECTIONS MAY BE SERIOUS AND DEATH HAS OCCURRED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ DO NOT USE JAPANESE ENCEPHALITIS (Imojev), MMR, CHOLERA (Vaxchora), ORAL TYPHOID, BCG, YELLOW FEVER, SMALLPOX (ACAM2000) OR VARICELLA LIVE VACCINES IN IMMUNOSUPPRESSED PEOPLE -- including ONCOLOGY AND TRANSPLANT PATIENTS, THOSE TAKING CYTOKINE MODULATORS, and ⚠️ INFANTS UP TO 6 MONTHS OF AGE EXPOSED IN UTERO TO CYTOKINE MODULATORS SUCH AS TNF-ALPHA ANTAGONISTS. ⚠️ INTRANASAL INFLUENZA VACCINE (FluMist) IS A LIVE VACCINE AND IS CONTRAINDICATED IN MODERATELY OR SEVERELY IMMUNOSUPPRESSED PATIENTS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ THE CORTICOSTEROID IMMUNOSUPPRESSION THRESHOLD, WHICH IS THE ONE NUMBER A GP IS MOST LIKELY TO NEED: live vaccines are contraindicated in those taking SYSTEMIC CORTICOSTEROIDS EQUIVALENT TO PREDNISOLONE ABOVE 2 mg/kg DAILY FOR MORE THAN 14 DAYS, OR ABOVE 1 mg/kg DAILY FOR MORE THAN 1 MONTH IN CHILDREN, OR PREDNISOLONE ABOVE 20 mg DAILY IN ADULTS. ⚠️ SEEK SPECIALIST ADVICE IF TAKING CHRONIC LOW-DOSE CORTICOSTEROIDS SUCH AS 5 mg PREDNISOLONE DAILY, AS THE DEGREE OF IMMUNOSUPPRESSION CAN VARY. ⚠️ PEOPLE USING INHALED CORTICOSTEROIDS CAN BE SAFELY VACCINATED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: HIV INFECTION: the risk from live vaccines and the immune response achieved VARY WITH DEGREE OF IMMUNODEFICIENCY (CD4 CELL COUNT) AND AGE, eg VERTICALLY ACQUIRED HIV. ⚠️ INDIVIDUALS WELL CONTROLLED ON ANTIRETROVIRAL THERAPY ARE LIKELY TO RESPOND WELL TO VACCINES -- SEEK SPECIALIST ADVICE. ONCOLOGY: INACTIVATED VACCINES CAN BE USED DURING CHEMOTHERAPY AND FOR 6 MONTHS AFTERWARDS, with possible poor response; AFTER THIS, IF COMPLETELY WELL AND NO LONGER IMMUNOSUPPRESSED, REVACCINATE. DISCUSS ANY IMMUNISATION WITH THE ONCOLOGIST
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ CONTACTS OF IMMUNOSUPPRESSED PEOPLE: CLOSE CONTACTS SHOULD BE VACCINATED AGAINST PERTUSSIS, MEASLES, MUMPS, RUBELLA, ROTAVIRUS WHERE INDICATED, CORONAVIRUS DISEASE, CHICKEN POX AND SHINGLES IF OVER 50 YEARS. ANNUAL INFLUENZA VACCINE IS ALSO RECOMMENDED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: TETANUS-PRONE WOUNDS: with 3 OR MORE PRIOR DOSES -- UNDER 5 YEARS SINCE THE LAST DOSE, NO IMMUNISATION FOR ANY WOUND; 5-10 YEARS, NONE FOR CLEAN MINOR WOUNDS BUT GIVE A BOOSTER FOR ALL OTHER WOUNDS; OVER 10 YEARS, GIVE A BOOSTER FOR ALL WOUNDS. With UNCERTAIN HISTORY OR FEWER THAN 3 DOSES, FINISH THE COURSE for both clean minor wounds and all other wounds
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ TETANUS IMMUNOGLOBULIN DOSE -- THE ONLY DRUG QUANTITY ON THE PAGE: GIVE 250 UNITS AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE, OR 500 UNITS IF MORE THAN 24 HOURS HAS ELAPSED, for non-clean wounds where the history is uncertain or fewer than 3 doses. ⚠️ IN HUMORAL IMMUNE DEFICIENCY INCLUDING HIV, GIVE TETANUS IMMUNOGLOBULIN for all wounds other than clean minor ones
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IMMIGRANTS: ⚠️ VACCINATION MAY BE INCOMPLETE AND DOCUMENTATION MAY BE MISSING. For a CHILD, begin catch-up vaccination as appropriate; for an ADULT, ⚠️ ENSURE VACCINATION AGAINST RUBELLA USING MMR, ESPECIALLY IN WOMEN OF CHILD-BEARING AGE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: HIGH-RISK OCCUPATIONS: HEALTHCARE WORKERS AND STUDENTS should be vaccinated against infections they may encounter INCLUDING HEPATITIS A AND TB, and be up to date with DIPHTHERIA, TETANUS, PERTUSSIS, POLIO, HEPATITIS B, INFLUENZA, CORONAVIRUS, VARICELLA, MEASLES, MUMPS AND RUBELLA. LABORATORY STAFF should also be vaccinated against pathogens they work with, such as JAPANESE ENCEPHALITIS, MENINGOCOCCAL INFECTION, TYPHOID, AUSTRALIAN BAT LYSSAVIRUS, HEPATITIS A, Q FEVER, YELLOW FEVER, ANTHRAX AND VACCINIA
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PRACTICE POINTS: ⚠️ RESUSCITATION EQUIPMENT, DRUGS AND A PROTOCOL FOR ANAPHYLAXIS MUST BE AVAILABLE AND CHECKED BEFORE EACH VACCINATION SESSION. ⚠️ MAINTAIN THE VACCINE FRIDGE AND OTHER COLD CHAIN COMPONENTS CORRECTLY AND CHECK BEFORE EACH WORKING DAY. VACCINE, DOSE, ROUTE AND ADMINISTRATION MUST BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE AUSTRALIAN IMMUNISATION HANDBOOK. ⚠️ ENSURE DOCUMENTATION -- INADEQUATE VACCINATION RECORDS WILL AFFECT CATCH-UP VACCINATION REQUIREMENTS. CHECK THE VACCINATION STATUS OF OTHER FAMILY MEMBERS AND OFFER CATCH-UP WHERE APPROPRIATE. REPORT ANY SIGNIFICANT ADVERSE EFFECT
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Immunisation' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/vaccines-chap/immunisation, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: TRAVELLERS should be immunised according to the most recent recommendations; CONSIDER PARTICULARLY VACCINATION AGAINST MEASLES, TETANUS, HEPATITIS B AND, DEPENDING ON AGE, INFLUENZA AND PNEUMOCOCCUS. VACCINATION AGAINST HEPATITIS A MAY ALSO BE USEFUL. AMH names Smartraveller, the WHO travel-advice pages and the US CDC Yellow Book as sources
